scope: Read-only source/evidence review and score arithmetic; no new kernel, compilation, NPU measurement or submission.
current_runtime: E128; official reference remains E127. Do not present Arena improvement as an official updated score.

classification.frozen_e131_variants: Not adopted because both whole-kernel screens regressed. Row2/Row4+tail are one family, each measured once.
classification.direct_fp4_family: Not rejected. A supported changed copy/setup/dependency mechanism can justify reopening.
classification.causal_evidence: Actual graph/source proves introduced copies and setup counts; hardware critical-path attribution is unmeasured. No additive stage-duration savings claim.
classification.down_priority: Feasible research hypothesis, not a demonstrated ranking solution. Include post-GeGLU quantization, assembly/broadcast, native terms and F32 partial/reduction costs.
classification.next_e131_diagnostic: Compare frozen E128 and E131v2 whole-image internal NPU spans using the existing E104 profiling method: packed/scale copies, table preparations, input readiness, direct streams and final consumer readiness. Preserve code/data and verify marker correspondence; compare source controls and account for trace effects. Reopen only on a concrete implementable change supported by dependency evidence, then measure the complete kernel again.
classification.score_strategy: QKV/O/FFN have equal geometric-mean weight. FFN-only must reduce total FFN cycles by the target percentages, not just the down stage.
